notes.title: INFINITE GEAR, New Update, New Game Mode
notes.content:
A new game mode is included in this new update.
INFINITE GEAR MODE
This new mode generates through a scenario creation algorithm through interconnected rooms in each game. Every time the player accesses a new game, the algorithm creates a new military base with enemies and traps that the player must overcome until he finds the ultimate weapon, a giant robotic mecha.
A game mode never seen before in a stealth and action game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526823/3a31203b7a2f074e653e3b0fd2821e02149259a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content:
Christmas Update!
Montenegro has a new mission: Save Santa!
Santa Claus has been kidnapped by the evil communists. Can you rescue him?

A completely new game mode that has never been seen in an infiltration game.

A generator of random bases in which you must overcome multiple challenges to rescue Santa. Every game is different!

Play Hundred Fires this Christmas and discover this new game mode in addition to the story mode and the training mode.

David Amado Fernández wishes you MERRY CHRISTMAS


Download at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824440/HUNDRED_FIRES_The_rising_of_red_star__EPISODE_1/
